_meta.source: ED Fig. 1 wrong-ZIP mis-geocode sensitivity, v2 (exact state-polygon flag). Flag: PWSID-prefix EPA region not among the coordinate's polygon-derived candidate regions (paper/_geo_flags.region_mismatch_mask against paper/assets/us_states_cb2023_5m.geojson; covering state, else nearest state within 3.0 degrees; identical rule to the ED Fig. 1 split-map exclusion). Supersedes misgeocode_sensitivity.json (bounding-box rule, retained), whose loose overlapping first-match-wins boxes falsely flagged ~64 percent of its 6,889 (correctly-located border systems). Sensitivity: T1/T4 xgboost on the canonical headline harness (train_and_evaluate task fns, ambient sources excluded, geographic holdout, seed 42) with flagged systems removed end-to-end. Gate A (tol 0.002): unperturbed run reproduces frozen results.json T1/T4 xgboost AUROC. Gate B: legacy bbox rule reproduces the frozen v1 n_flagged/n_mapped on the same coords frame. Material-degradation escalation band: |delta AUROC| > 0.02.
